callouts.label: Welcoming Climate
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents welcoming climate.
callouts.description: Belonging, respect, and predictable routines support prevention and reporting.
callouts.ap_tip: Climate is built through daily behavior and fair systems. Students should not have to earn dignity.

callouts.label: Trusted Reporting
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents trusted reporting.
callouts.description: Students need clear, accessible ways to report concerns without retaliation.
callouts.ap_tip: Take every report seriously. Protect privacy as far as safety permits.

callouts.label: Mental Health Support
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents mental health support.
callouts.description: Counselors and referral pathways support early help and crisis response.
callouts.ap_tip: Care should be culturally safe and accessible. Peers are connectors, not sole responders.

callouts.label: Accessible Design
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents accessible design.
callouts.description: Entrances, routes, alarms, information, and procedures must include people with varied disabilities.
callouts.ap_tip: Plan access before an emergency. Include users in design.

callouts.label: Emergency Communication
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents emergency communication.
callouts.description: Clear, redundant communication helps people act during changing conditions.
callouts.ap_tip: Use visual, auditory, and accessible channels. Rumor control matters.

callouts.label: Trained Staff
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents trained staff.
callouts.description: Staff need role-specific practice for prevention, first aid, evacuation, shelter, and reunification.
callouts.ap_tip: Training should be realistic without traumatizing students. Review after drills and events.

callouts.label: First Aid and AED
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents first aid and aed.
callouts.description: Accessible supplies and trained responders improve emergency readiness.
callouts.ap_tip: Maintain equipment and clear access. Follow current certified guidance.

callouts.label: Evacuation
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents evacuation.
callouts.description: Evacuation plans use safe routes, accountability, accessibility, and alternate options.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not block responder access. Conditions determine whether evacuation is appropriate.

callouts.label: Shelter Procedures
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents shelter procedures.
callouts.description: Some hazards require sheltering rather than leaving.
callouts.ap_tip: Procedures differ by hazard. Follow official instructions and support access needs.

callouts.label: Reunification
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents reunification.
callouts.description: A reunification plan connects students with authorized caregivers safely and accurately.
callouts.ap_tip: Communication reduces confusion. Plan for language and disability access.

callouts.label: Digital Safety
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents digital safety.
callouts.description: Secure systems, privacy practices, reporting, and media literacy reduce digital harm.
callouts.ap_tip: Preserve evidence when safe. Coordinate technology and human support.

callouts.label: Student Voice
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents student voice.
callouts.description: Students notice barriers and can improve plans, climate, and communication.
callouts.ap_tip: Participation should be meaningful, not symbolic. Share decisions and feedback.
